text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our day out together, Yukino Bijin and 
I 
stopped by an affordable cosmetics shop. 
Apparently, there was a trendy new lip 
product she had her eye on.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This is it, this one right here! 
The "viral lippie" everyone's talkin' 
about. 
It's wicked popular on Umastagram too.

—My! If it isn't Yukino-san and 
Trainer-san. 
Did you two come to check this out as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Royce-san! 
Ehehe, yes, it's all the rage right now. 
My classmates have it too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oho, so its visibility is truly 
exceptional, then. 
If I were to feature this on my socials, 
ever so casually...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's sure to boost my image as a stylish 
gal with her 
finger on the pulse of the latest trends! 
Now then, which shade is the most 
popular~? ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, the two amicably began testing 
out 
various colors using the store samples. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...The color payoff doesn't match how it 
looks. 
It's rather sticky, too. Honestly, it's 
pretty lackluster.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: This craze—it might not last very long.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Is... is that so...? 
Even though it looks so sparkly and purty?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well, precisely. The packaging was what 
caught on. 
Yet the quality itself is mediocre at 
best. 
Initial hype may be strong, but repeat 
demand looks rather bleak.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I've analyzed countless fads over time, 
and in the end, anything lacking true 
substance quickly fades away.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Golly... it's a harsh world out there. 
If I don't... have real ability, then I...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because she herself was currently 
causing quite a stir 
in the racing world, Yukino Bijin's 
expression clouded with worry. 
However...
choice_data_list:
With your ability, I know you'll be just 
fine!

With your ability, I know you'll be just 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You possess undeniable potential, 
Yukino-san. 
Ah, that reminds me... There is something 
I'd love to show you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know this blush! 
City-san said she owns every single 
shade...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I bet she does! 
After all, it's the ultimate staple: "When 
in doubt, grab this!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! It really is stocked in every 
store, isn't it? 
Even I know about it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You see, even this cult-classic blush was 
tossed around 
by fickle trends when it first launched.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Word of mouth set it ablaze, making it an 
overnight sensation! ♪ 
Yet the craze died down just as quickly! 
Excess stock piled up from ramped-up 
production, and debts mounted.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the company president believed: 
"True quality never goes out of style"...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Guided by that spirit, they steadily 
refined its formula without arrogance, 
and after endless minor adjustments... 
it became their flagship product, enjoying 
steady, lasting demand!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So they didn't let the hype sway 'em, 
and just kept workin' quietly and 
diligently...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Truly magnificent things transcend 
eras.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And one day— 
they become legends!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Legends"...! 
My, that sounds mighty cool.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If something's truly amazin'... 
people will eventually come to understand, 
won't they?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now let me see the back of your 
hand. 
I wonder if that pink shade might suit 
you, Yukino-san?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hyawaa~...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Gosh! 
It's so pretty... so soft and airy...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm... I'm gonna buy this right now!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Fufufu! 
She really fell in love with it, didn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Hm, hmhmm~♪
choice_data_list: Looks like you found something great.
Looks like you found something great.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I hope I can become like this too... 
Oh, maybe I should wear this for my races?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I reckon it'll serve as 
a wonderful good-luck charm!
